name: posixloom-runtime
description: Portable POSIX command runtime for Windows automation and AI harnesses

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:host
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && cargo fmt --manifest-path native/posixloom-host/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --manifest-path native/posixloom-host/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path native/posixloom-host/Cargo.toml && npm test && cargo test --locked --manifest-path native/posixloom-host/Cargo.toml
